generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model User {
  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  email     String   @unique
  username  String   @unique
  password  String
  bio       String?
  image     String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  followers Follow[]   @relation("Following")
  following Follow[]   @relation("Followers")
  articles  Article[]
  favorites Favorite[]
  comments  Comment[]
}

model Follow {
  id          Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  followerId  Int
  followingId Int
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  follower  User @relation("Followers", fields: [followerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  following User @relation("Following", fields: [followingId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([followerId, followingId])
}

model Article {
  id          Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  slug        String   @unique
  title       String
  description String
  body        String
  authorId    Int
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  author    User         @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  tags      ArticleTag[]
  favorites Favorite[]
  comments  Comment[]
}

model Tag {
  id       Int          @id @default(autoincrement())
  name     String       @unique
  articles ArticleTag[]
}

model ArticleTag {
  articleId Int
  tagId     Int

  article Article @relation(fields: [articleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  tag     Tag     @relation(fields: [tagId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([articleId, tagId])
}

model Favorite {
  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  userId    Int
  articleId Int
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user    User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  article Article @relation(fields: [articleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, articleId])
}

model Comment {
  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  body      String
  authorId  Int
  articleId Int
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  author  User    @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  article Article @relation(fields: [articleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

Based on my analysis of the codebase, here are the three answers:

1. **Where is it guaranteed that no two articles share the same slug?**
   `prisma/schema.prisma :: slug` — `@unique` constraint on Article.slug field

2. **Where is it computed whether the requesting (current) user follows an article's author?**
   `src/infrastructure/repositories/PrismaUserRepository.ts :: isFollowing` — Queries Follow table by composite key

3. **Where is the authentication token verified on incoming requests?**
   `src/presentation/middleware/AuthMiddleware.ts :: authenticate` — Calls `tokenService.verify(token)` on line 25
